# CURRENT RUN ALL TASKS OPERATING STANDARD — 2026-11-23

**Schedule & precedence.** The one existing Run All Tasks automation is enabled daily at **3:01 a.m. America/New_York**. Its separate 1 a.m. phone wake is unchanged. Earlier manual-only/paused directions in archived notes are superseded. A routine execution must never turn off or reschedule itself. This source preserves the full topical checklist; the automation's concise live instructions control runtime, task verification, cleanup and current user authorizations. Do not create duplicate routines.

**Every-run lifecycle upkeep.** Maintain one active entry/selection tracker. For each giveaway, contest, instant win, Instagram entry, beta or free-product testing application record the exact sponsor/campaign/round, primary rules URL, entry URL, account/method, verification evidence, verified start/close date with timezone, draw/announcement date, next check, outcome, claim/shipping deadline, and current status. Missing or inaccessible official dates are explicitly `unknown — verify`, never invented; search sponsor's official rules, original dated post, and announcements to fill missing fields. The day after closing is the first winner check; recheck scheduled announcement and later until resolved or outside the one-calendar-month check window. If prize/selection/claim/delivery unresolved, preserve and follow up beyond window. Once official results settle with no outstanding claim, or a closed/removed promotion passes the existing window, purge obsolete event-specific data from **routine-managed** logs and entry trackers rather than accumulating indefinite history; remove closed Instagram event entries. Do not delete personal emails, user-created social posts/comments, survey responses or unrelated project documents as a side effect. Unfollow Instagram accounts originally followed **only** for finished promotions after their last active campaign, except never auto-unfollow **Govee, MOVA, Dreame or Eufy**. Do not unfollow sponsors still needed for active promotions or existing account relationships. Verify every actual change; leave blocked or uncertain removals pending, never claim completed cleanup without evidence. Audit before deletion and keep pending win/shipment proof.

**Beta/free-product lifecycle.** Continue all eligible legitimate US free physical products, samples and physical-hardware testing programs (including electronics, car-care, tools, diagnostics, solar, robot vacuums, pets and smart home). Betabound excludes software-only testing. Track as discovered/open/applied/selected/rejected/closed/fulfilled; do not reapply, invent requirements or discard active tester projects, agreements, deliveries, feedback or selection follow-ups. After safely closed, purge stale event-specific records with the same standards. Clearly mark free vs paid, purchase/rebate conditions and location restrictions. Never buy or redeem without explicit authorization.

**End-of-run audit & recovery.** Never mark entire task complete because one page loaded or form was drafted. For each required lane report verified action with evidence, checked/no fresh result, already done, timeout, blocked, or not run; include point/coin increments, Instagram eligible/entered count, applications and adjustments actually confirmed. If an app/login/CAPTCHA/approval/page fails, capture its URL and last safe step, skip promptly, continue independent lanes, then group unresolved actions and errors at the end. Never stop or disable the routine over a partial blocker. Keep concise recent run summaries and one canonical active tracker, retiring obsolete daily verbose logs after auditing unique active data. Do not delete historical records from unrelated projects or user-created platforms.

# RUN DAILY — REQUIRED MASTER SCOPE

This file is authoritative for the Run Daily project. A Run Daily execution is incomplete unless every REQUIRED section below is checked and reported as either a verified hit, a known/suppressed item, a timeout/blocked lane, or "nothing new verified" after an actual fresh check. Omitted, not-run and incomplete checks must be named explicitly.

## REQUIRED 1 — Giveaways / entries / promos
- Giveaways, sweepstakes, contests, daily/weekly/recurring entries, instant-win, surveys, alternate-entry methods
- Blind boxes, mystery boxes, discovery boxes
- Lucky draws, spin-to-win, wheels
- Beta, product tester, ambassador, explorer, sampling and free-product programs
- Free samples, free merchandise, free-with-purchase, launch/first-customer offers
- App-only, member-only, points/credits, email, QR, retailer, referral and community campaigns
- Social/community discovery: Instagram, Reddit, Facebook, TikTok, forums and brand communities
- Paid-social landing pages where discoverable
- Slickdeals Daily Draw
- Pet freebies and permanent free/near-free pet offers

## Browser execution and evidence
- Use the built-in Chrome/Cloud Browser for live interactions and manual control; prefer connected service tools for supported operations. Never use the Oracle Browser Agent, Oracle remote browser or Oracle manual-entry handoff.
- TinyFish is a fallback only when 100% necessary because the built-in browser cannot complete a necessary authorized step. Reconcile a timed-out action before retrying it; preserve the user's prepared manual tabs.
- Use scoped entry forms, fill primary and confirmation email fields, and ignore unrelated search/newsletter controls. Leave unknown screener answers for the user. Visible human verification and rules prohibiting automation require manual action.
- Never report entry confirmation from HTTP 200, page loading, form preparation or a generic pre-existing thank-you. Retain confirmation evidence and New York local-day/month duplicate limits.
- Wheel actions require a verified positive free balance; unresolved counters and paid points remain blocked. Timeouts cancel owned browser pages and requests without closing the user's manual tabs.
- Publish scrubbed complete result metadata: Instagram handle/post coverage, captions, hits, numeric study IDs, campaign identifiers and verification errors. Report partial coverage explicitly. Preserve still-active campaign details and unresolved win/claim proof when updating last-run state; purge closed-out event records according to the 2026-11-23 lifecycle rule.
- Check current connector availability on each run. For Gmail, test the connected profile and then perform the requested searches; do not carry an old tool-unavailable diagnosis forward. Empty searches and connector failures are different outcomes.
- Recall checks use the official NHTSA API. Make/model/year results do not establish VIN-specific recall applicability or an all-clear.
- Schedules remain in their existing enabled/paused state unless the user requests a scheduling change.

## REQUIRED REPORT CONTRACT
Put the results directly in chat. A report file is optional backup, never the primary answer. Every explicitly requested Run Daily must show the status of every required category, including checked/no new verified result, hit, blocked, partial/incomplete, suppressed/DONE, or not run. Never use a generic "nothing new" for an omitted lane.

Every Run Daily report must visibly cover:
1. New actionable entries/promos
2. Confirmed automated entries

A report that omits any required category is incomplete.
